Cricket pitch ka ek sira 0, doosra 1: batsman run lete hue beech mein ruk gaya. Beech ka mark 0 se ek gap par hai, aur 0 se 1 tak 2 barabar gaps hain: isliye 1/2. Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Sadak 0 se 1 kilometre, 7 barabar gaps mein kati hai. Ek khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh ek pakki jagah hai, uska number 1/7 kilometre. Ab wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Khilona us par pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?

director.text: 6 kilometre

director.text: pata nahi
Neeche ki taraf ungli 0 se pehle mark tak le jao aur gap gino; phir ungli wapas 0 par rakho aur 1 tak saare gap gino. In do gintiyon se kilometre batao. Ab tum batao.
director.card: Ab wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Khilona us par pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?

director.text: one sixth

Haan, sahi hai: yeh sadak 6 barabar gaps mein kati hai, aur khilona ghar se bas ek gap chala, toh 1/6 kilometre par. Ab us sawaal par lautte hain jo humne pehle chhoda tha. Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1 upon 3

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 3 gaps mein se ek gap tak: 1/3. Ab 0 aur 1 ke beech 6 marks hain. Neeche wala number gaps se aata hai: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/7 hai. Ab socho, ek aur line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hon, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. Wahan kitne gaps banenge?
director.card: Ab socho, ek aur line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hon, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. Wahan kitne gaps banenge?

director.text: eight

Haan, bilkul theek. Marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door. Ab wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein bhi kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Ab wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein bhi kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/8 sahi nahi hai. Ek aur dhang se samajhte hain. Yahan 2 barabar gap bhi hain, aur 5 bhi. Gap jitne zyada, har gap utna chhota: 1/5 ka gap 1/2 wale se chhota. Pehla mark 1/5 hai, aur line 7 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?
director.card: Pehla mark 1/5 hai, aur line 7 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?

director.text: picture dikhao

Upar wali patti ka pehla gap rangin hai, 1/5. Neeche wali patti utni hi lambi hai par saat barabar gaps mein, uska pehla gap bhi baayein kinaare se dekho. Batao, 1/7 ka mark 0 aur 1/5 ke beech lagega, ya 1/5 ke baad?
director.card: Pehla mark 1/5 hai, aur line 7 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?

director.text: between 0 and 1/5 hai na

Haan, sahi hai: 1/7 ka gap 1/5 ke gap se chhota hai, toh 1/7 wala mark 0 aur 1/5 ke beech aata hai. Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. Ab wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein bhi kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 wala

Bilkul sahi, kyunki jitne zyada gaps, utna chhota har gap: 10 gaps ke saath pehla mark 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas aata hai. Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. Board par abhi sirf beech wala khamba hai. 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge.

director.text: chaar gap

Haan, 4 gap: dono siron par bhi ek-ek gap hai. Doori gaps se naapte hain, khambon se nahi: khamba bas ek jagah hai, aur ghar se pehle khambe tak ka chalna ek gap hai. Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: dhai sau metre

Haan, bilkul theek. 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: pehle main try karun?
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1 upon 11

Haan, sahi hai: 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11. Line ek baar 4 barabar gaps mein kati hai, ek baar 12 mein. Inke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Line ek baar 4 barabar gaps mein kati hai, ek baar 12 mein. Inke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: Bilkul sahi, kyunki 12 barabar gaps ka har gap 4 wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/12 wala pehla mark 0 ke sabse paas hai. Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
director.card: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?

director.text: pehle mark par

Sahi jawab. 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne. Yahan tak theek hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh number line wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Abhi apne kaam par wapas chalte hain. Is baar line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 gap chalo, ek, do, aur hum 2/3 par aa gaye. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Is baar line 8 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?
director.card: Is baar line 8 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?

seams.form: Abhi apne kaam par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: Hindi mein bolo
Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon. Ab poori line 8 gap mein bhi bati hai. 0 se 5 gap aage jao, toh kaunsa fraction aata hai?
director.card: Ab poori line 8 gap mein bhi bati hai. 0 se 5 gap aage jao, toh kaunsa fraction aata hai?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon.

director.text: 5/8 par
Haan, sahi hai: har gap 1/8 ka, aur aise 5 gap mile toh 5/8. Sixer ki baat tumne ki thi: tab tumhare saath kaun tha?
Rohit

Arre wah, Rohit! Achha kiya jo bataya. Theek hai, ab phir se dhyaan idhar lagate hain. Ab 1/3 wale 3 gap chalkar dekho: teesre gap ke ant par hum theek 1 par hain, isliye wahan 3/3 = 1. Teeno gap milkar 0 se 1 tak ki poori line bhar dete hain. Ab socho, ek doosri line 1/5 wale gaps mein kati ho. 0 se theek 1 tak aise kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: Ab socho, ek doosri line 1/5 wale gaps mein kati ho. 0 se theek 1 tak aise kitne gap chalne honge?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab phir se dhyaan idhar lagate hain.

j2.line: Arre wah, Rohit! Achha kiya jo bataya.

director.text: 4 sahi nahi hai. 4 gap ke baad bhi tum 1 se pehle ho. Is line par 1 tab aaya jab upar aur neeche ek hi number hua, 3/3; 1/5 wale gaps mein bhi wahi socho. Har gap 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se theek 1 tak kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: Ab socho, ek doosri line 1/5 wale gaps mein kati ho. 0 se theek 1 tak aise kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 5

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 1/5 ke 5 gap se 5/5 = 1. Ab line ke 6 barabar gaps hain. Beech ka mark 3/6 = 1/2 hai, kyunki 3, 6 ka aadha hai. 2/6 usse pehle aata hai, 5/6 baad mein. 0 se 1 ki ek nayi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 4/10 beech se pehle aayega, ya beech ke baad?
director.card: 0 se 1 ki ek nayi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 4/10 beech se pehle aayega, ya beech ke baad?

director.text: before the middle hai na

Haan, bilkul theek. 10 gaps ka beech 5 gap par hai, 5/10; 4/10 usse ek gap pehle hai, toh beech se pehle. Chalo, ab ek sawaal saath mein line par karte hain. Ek number line 0 se 1 tak hai. Is par 2/5 ka mark dhoondhna hai. 2/5 mein kaunsa number line ke barabar gaps ginta hai: 2 ya 5?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal saath mein line par karte hain.

director.text: paanch gaps banenge

Haan, 5: neeche wala 5 batata hai 0 se 1 kitne barabar gaps mein kate. Ab 0 se ek-ek gap gino, har gap 1/5 ka: har gap ke ant par ek mark hai. Tumhari baari: 2/5 ke liye 0 ke baad kaunse mark par rukoge?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 2/5 ke liye 0 ke baad kaunse mark par rukoge?

director.text: the 1st mark

Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Pehla mark 0 se sirf ek gap par hai, 1/5 par; upar wala 2 kehta hai ki gap aur chalne hain, toh pehle mark par rukna jaldi hai. 2/5 dikhane ke liye, 5 gaps wali is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par rukoge?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 2/5 ke liye 0 ke baad kaunse mark par rukoge?

director.text: doosre mark par

Haan, sahi hai. Toh poora jawab: 2/5, 0 ke baad doosra mark hai, kyunki 2/5 matlab 1/5 ke 2 gap, aur 0 se 2 gap chalkar hum doosre mark par pahunchte hain. Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 5 marks lage hain, aur saare gaps ek jitne hain. 0 ke baad chautha mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 5 marks lage hain, aur saare gaps ek jitne hain. 0 ke baad chautha mark kaunsa fraction hai?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo.

director.text: 4 by 6

Bilkul sahi. 5 marks se 6 barabar gaps bante hain, aur chautha mark 4 gaps par hai: 4/6, jo 2/3 ke barabar hai. Line par 1/5 wale gap bhi hain, aur 1/10 wale bhi. 1/10 ke kitne gap chalkar tum 3/5 tak pahunchoge?
director.card: Line par 1/5 wale gap bhi hain, aur 1/10 wale bhi. 1/10 ke kitne gap chalkar tum 3/5 tak pahunchoge?

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. Ise ek baar aise sochte hain. Lamba gap 1/3 hai, aur chhota gap usse aadha, 1/6. 2 lambe gap 2/3 par rukte hain, 2 chhote 2/6 par. 1/3 ke 2 gap 2/3 tak gaye. Ab 1/6 ke 3 gap: woh 2/3 se pehle rukenge, ya baad mein?
director.card: 1/3 ke 2 gap 2/3 tak gaye. Ab 1/6 ke 3 gap: woh 2/3 se pehle rukenge, ya baad mein?

seams.form: Ise ek baar aise sochte hain.

director.text: pehle ruk jaayenge
Haan, bilkul theek: 1/6 ke 3 gap sirf beech tak jaate hain, aur 2/3 beech se aage hai. Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. 0 se 3/5 tak 1/10 ke kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: Line par 1/5 wale gap bhi hain, aur 1/10 wale bhi. 1/10 ke kitne gap chalkar tum 3/5 tak pahunchoge?

seams.form: Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: Nahi, 3 theek nahi. 3 toh tumne 1/5 wale bade gap gine hain; sawaal 1/10 wale chhote gaps ka hai, aur chhote gaps se utni hi door jaane mein gap zyada lagte hain. Line par 1/5 wale gap bhi hain, aur 1/10 wale bhi. 1/10 ke kitne gap chalkar tum 3/5 tak pahunchoge?
director.card: Line par 1/5 wale gap bhi hain, aur 1/10 wale bhi. 1/10 ke kitne gap chalkar tum 3/5 tak pahunchoge?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 6

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki har 1/5 gap mein 1/10 ke do gap aate hain, toh 3/5 tak 1/10 ke 6 gap hain. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 3/4 do number hain, 3 aur 4. 0 se 1 ki line par 3/4 ki jagah batane ke liye tum kitne mark par ungli rakhoge?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 3/4 do number hain, 3 aur 4. 0 se 1 ki line par 3/4 ki jagah batane ke liye tum kitne mark par ungli rakhoge?

director.text: ek hi

Bilkul sahi. 3/4 akela ek number hai, toh line par uski sirf ek jagah hai: 0 se 3 gap chalkar, wahi ek mark. Ab fraction 1 ke aage bhi jaayenge: line kabhi 2 tak chalegi, kabhi 3 tak, aur dekhenge ki 1 se bade fraction kahan aate hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan

Yeh rahi 0 se 2 tak ki line. Har poore ke 4 barabar gaps hain, toh 4 gap chalkar 1 aata hai: 4/4 = 1. 1 ke aage bhi gaps usi size mein chalte rehte hain. Ab line 1/5 wale gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 6 gap chalo: ab tum kis fraction par ho?
director.card: Ab line 1/5 wale gaps mein bhi kati hai. 0 se 6 gap chalo: ab tum kis fraction par ho?

director.text: 6 by 5

Haan, bilkul theek: 5 gap se 1, chhatha gap 6/5 par. 0 se 1/4 ke chhe gap chalo: 4 gap 1 tak, phir do aur, 6/4 tak. Upar wala number 6 neeche ke 4 se bada, isliye 6/4, 1 ke aage hai. Ab 1/2 wale gap bhi bane hain. 0 se aise 4 gap chalkar line ke kis number tak pahunchoge?
director.card: Ab 1/2 wale gap bhi bane hain. 0 se aise 4 gap chalkar line ke kis number tak pahunchoge?

director.text: chaar bata do

Sahi jawab, kyunki do gap ek poora hain, toh 4 gap 2 poore. Yeh line 0 se 3 tak hai, har poore ke 3 barabar gaps. Teen gaps chalo toh 1 aata hai, 3/3 = 1. Teen-teen gaps ka har group ek poora hai. 7/3 ke 7 gaps ko teen-teen ke group mein rakho. Har group mein theek teen gap hon, toh kitne group bante hain?
director.card: 7/3 ke 7 gaps ko teen-teen ke group mein rakho. Har group mein theek teen gap hon, toh kitne group bante hain?

director.text: 2 group

Haan, sahi hai. 7/3 ke 7 gaps mein teen-teen gaps ke 2 group bante hain, 6/3 = 2, aur 1 gap bachta hai. Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain. Ek number line 0 se 2 tak hai, barabar gaps mein kati hui. Is par 7/4 ka mark dhoondhna hai. 7/4 ke 7 gap 0 se chalo: 1 tak kitne gap lagte hain?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain.

director.text: four
Haan, 4: 4/4 = 1, ek poora. Baaki gap 1 ke aage chalte hain, aur 7/4 ka mark 1 aur 2 ke beech aata hai. Ab tum 7/4 ko ek poore aur ek fraction mein kaise bologe?
director.card: Ab tum 7/4 ko ek poore aur ek fraction mein kaise bologe?

director.text: 1 poora aur 3/4

Bilkul sahi. Toh poora jawab: 7/4 = 1 aur 3/4, kyunki saat chauthai mein se chaar chauthai milkar ek poora banate hain, aur teen chauthai bachte hain. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Ek line lo, 0 se 3 tak, har poora 3 barabar gaps mein. 5/3 kaun se do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?
director.card: Ek line lo, 0 se 3 tak, har poora 3 barabar gaps mein. 5/3 kaun se do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?

director.text: ek aur do ke beech
Haan, bilkul theek. 3/3 = 1 aur 6/3 = 2, aur 5/3 dono ke beech hai. Line 0 se 2 tak. 1/6 ke 11 gap chalo, ya 1/12 ke 11 gap. 0 se zyada door kaun gaya: 11/6 ya 11/12?
director.card: Line 0 se 2 tak. 1/6 ke 11 gap chalo, ya 1/12 ke 11 gap. 0 se zyada door kaun gaya: 11/6 ya 11/12?

director.text: 11/6 wala

Sahi jawab, kyunki 1/6 ka gap 1/12 wale se do guna hai, toh 11/6, yaani 1 aur 5/6, 11/12 se aage hai. Is line par 0, 1, 2 aur 3 likhe hain, aur har do poore numbers ke beech 5 barabar gaps hain. 2 ke baad doosra mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0, 1, 2 aur 3 likhe hain, aur har do poore numbers ke beech 5 barabar gaps hain. 2 ke baad doosra mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai. 2 tak 10 gaps, aur 2 gap aage: 12/5. Aaj jo kuch seekha, us sab par ek aakhri sawaal aa raha hai. Ek line 0 se 2 tak hai. 0 aur 1 ke beech 6 marks hain, aur 1 aur 2 ke beech bhi 6, sab barabar doori par. 0 se 9 gap chalo toh kis fraction par pahunchoge?

Bilkul sahi: 6 marks se har poore ke 7 barabar gaps bante hain, toh har gap 1/7; 0 se 9 gap chalkar 9/7 aata hai, yaani 1 aur 2/7. Aaj dekha ki har fraction ki line par ek pakki jagah hai, jo gaps ginkar milti hai. Jab upar wala number neeche wale number se bada ho, toh fraction 1 ke aage aata hai. Aaj ki padhai mein kuch aisa tha jo achha laga?
sawaal achhe the
Achha, theek hai, batane ke liye shukriya. Aaj ek kaam tumne khud karke dikhaya: 0 se gaps ginkar 2 ke baad doosre mark ka naam rakha. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge.
